game.q: the third man gives so easily. why?
opts: he had more than the others
he remembered it was given to him
he guessed the stranger was an angel

wrong.guess: he didn’t know. he gave anyway.

game.right: YES. he never forgot it was a gift. his answer starts with “i was blind.”

end.line: three men were given everything. only one remembered where it came from, and gave.

cliff.s1: a sacred stone. a cloak with four corners.
cliff.s2: and a whole city that trusted one man.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: the man they called trustworthy.

share: three men. three valleys. one memory. a story the Prophet ﷺ told, on infinite hill
